The only way we will be able to introduce this is by placing the reagents into the cauldron directly. Alchemist Arbington will have more information on that, so be sure to speak with him at your earliest convenience.
progress: We know that each cauldron employs a different mix of reagents to generate its plague-inducing toxin; likewise, we know that we will need to develop a counter agent that is unique for each cauldron. Your sample from Dalson's Tears will be the key to figure out that cauldron's distinct reagent requirement.

5244.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
desc: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.
objectives: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.
details: The story behind Kel'Theril is one of a cursed race, bound to the place where they attempted an unfortunate ritual...

The highborne that you will find there once stole a sacred artifact, believing that they could siphon its power for themselves, becoming even more powerful. In their efforts, the relic shattered in a huge explosion, driving the pieces below the ice of the lake...
Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper if you'd like to learn more; he has recently visited the area and can tell you more.
completion: Well, sure, I can tell you more about Kel'Theril. Mind you now, I'm no historian, but I can tell ya about what I saw there...

5508.name: Corruptor's Scourgestones
progress: A Corruptor's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's overlords.  A powerful being that holds a position of authority over the Scourge will always possess one.  To slay such a malevolent creature would surely advance the cause of the Argent Dawn, and all good causes!$B$BOn behalf of the Argent Dawn, I will give you a valor token in exchange for just a single one of these insignia.  Use caution in acquiring one, $N - such powerful beings are not to be trifled with.
completion: Congratulations, $N - I am pleased to award you with an Argent Dawn valor token!$B$BTo acquire a valor token in such a manner indicates that you are a true hero in the cause of good. We value all effort brought to bear against the Scourge, but to take down one of their leaders is to truly deliver onto them a crushing defeat!$B$BFor the Dawn, my $Gbrother:sister;!

5628.name: Returning Home
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: Ah, yes, hello, $N? I'm glad you stopped to talk for a moment. You are a far way from home at such a young age--I admire such ambition. I wish when I was younger I could have mustered the courage to travel the world.

There was a priestess of your order here looking for you not too long ago. She said it was very urgent you returned to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and speak to Priestess Alathea--it had something to do with your training. I wouldn't dally too long if you can help it.
completion: Wonderful, you've returned home, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

5652.name: Hex of Weakness
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
details: I sent here to make sure that you not wander too far from home, $N. They send me to make sure you return home because Ur'kyo, greatest of our priests, wish to speak to you. You go there. You got to the Valley of Spirits in the orc city and you speak to Ur'kyo. He wait for you now.
completion: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.

5676.name: Arcane Feedback
desc: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
details: It is time for you to return to Stormwind, young one. Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that.
B I do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me.
B You will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.
completion: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
I would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.

5724.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
desc: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
details: You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.
Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
completion: Excellent, $N. Thank you.
Magatha told me that if you were successful in finding her clansman that you be given this. Please, take it in thanks.
progress: Were you able to find anything, $N? Any clues as to why one of her clansman had to die needlessly would be helpful.

5844.name: Welcome!
desc: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
objectives: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
details: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Vorn Skyseer in Camp Narache. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
completion: You are indeed a special hero, $N. We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
progress: Greetings! It is a pleasure to meet you!$B$BI see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.

5892.name: Irondeep Supplies
desc: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
objectives: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
details: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
progress: Do you have the supplies, $N? We can never have enough!
completion: Well done! I'll put these supplies to good use! Thanks, $N!

6084.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
details: Those crag boars are quite burly; maybe you'd like something with a little more finesse? Alright then, I've got jus' the thing. South and east of here, you'll find large white cats called snow leopards. Just like an elegantly-carved rifle, behind their beautiful exterior lies a powerful fighter, capable of doing extreme damage. You'll find them to be much more agile an' swift than the boar you tamed.
Take this taming rod and see how you like the snow leopard.
completion: When I feel you've learned enough, I will grant you the ability to choose any pet of your liking.
progress: What do you think of the snow leopard, $N?

6132.name: Get Me Out of Here!
desc: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.
objectives: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.
details: Get me out of here!
I came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines. I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk! I think they want to eat me!
Get me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big! He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.
Let's hurry, $N. Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...
completion: My sister Melizza said you'd be coming. Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!
progress: Have you seen my sister Melizza? She's always on the go, which gets her into trouble all the time.

6324.name: Return to Podrig
desc: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
details: The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok. If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.
Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.
You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there. Speak with me again when you are ready.
completion: Good work, $N. These weapons will ensure our Deathguards don't get caught unprepared.
You have done a valuable service for our Dark Lady.
progress: $N, you return. Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
desc: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
details: Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:
B"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
completion: This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.
Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
progress: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
desc: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
objectives: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.$B
details: I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.
Luckily fer ye, I know a guy. He's a goblin and probably the best cook on Kalimdor.
Ayep, that's the bad news, $g lad:missy; - ye got to travel to Kalimdor. Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. He'll set ya straight.$B
completion: <Dirge spits out leather.>
Pfftey...
B<Dirge hacks loudly.>
What? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates, $R.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
desc: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
objectives: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
details: A force of elemental scouts was sent to the eastern plaguelands of Lordaeron, and the disease of that place twisted and infected them. The Waterlords cannot allow this affront to our purity!

Take this vial. In it is a quantity of one aspect of Neptulon. If used on the plagued elementals it will fight the poison within their bodies and cure them! But their inner conflict will drive them into a surging madness.
Defeat the discordant surges and bring me their bracers of binding.
completion: You have done well, $C. The corrupted elementals you cured were an outrage to all bodies of water. Our strength lies in our purity and if we are to win our war with the others, we must remain strong.
progress: Do you have the bracers?

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
desc: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.
objectives: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.
details: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.

Vyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.
You must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.
completion: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.
progress: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...

7068.name: Shadowshard Fragments
desc: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.
details: Strong magics be found in the centaur holy place... the holy place of Maraudon. The Desolace tribes of centaur protect that place wit' their lives, but they canna stop us from takin' what we need.
You, you head to this Maraudon place and find the rock creatures made of shadowshard. You bring me the purple crystals, and Uthel'nay make you somethin' for your time.
The place be dangerous, so maybe you be bringing some friends.
completion: Ah, these be perfect for me magics. Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... me got much studyin' to do.
progress: You find the crystals yet? Rituals of power, spells of great strength - those shadowshards maybe very helpful in all kind of arcane magics.

7164.name: Honored Amongst the Clan
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 17905, 'target': 'Frostwolf Insignia Rank 2', 'text': None}
details: It is good to see you again, $C. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.
Your time has come again, $N. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.
Present your insignia.
completion: <Warmaster Laggrond salutes.>
Go, $N! Continue your defense of the Frostwolf. This war must be won! For Drek'Thar! For the Warchief!
progress: It is good to see you again, $c. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.$b$bYour time has come again, $N. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.$b$bPresent your insignia.

7500.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
As time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.
progress: You have recovered a tome!

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
desc: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
objectives: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
details: As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows ever so slightly. The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.
It would seem that the barding has been blessed. As per Lord Shadowbreaker's instructions, you should now return with it to him in Stormwind.
completion: You've come far, my friend. Your barding is now suitably prepared for the last task at hand.
You will be using this barding to harness your charger once the task of redemption is complete. Before that, however, you will have a monumental struggle to overcome. Your time draws near - huzzah!
There is one last item that needs to be made before we begin this, $N. Hopefully your resourcefulness has not departed you since you had your barding made...
progress: $N, you're back! Were you able to successfully deal with Merideth Carlson and Tendris Warpwood?  Honestly, I'm not sure which one is a greater threat at times...

7788.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $c. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N, and I shall reward you.

7812.name: Additional Runecloth
progress: Greetings once again, $N! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of the Gnomeregan Exiles.$B$BWhenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
completion: $N - without heroes like you working on behalf of the gnomes, we'd surely suffer. Thank you for your continued efforts!

7836.name: A Donation of Runecloth
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 14047, 'target': 'Runecloth', 'text': None}
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

With all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
progress: $n, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. We are in absolutely dire need of runecloth, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past.$B$BIf you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

7884.name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc
progress: Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.$B$B$N, can you make those leggings? If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward...
completion: Great, you made them!  These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes.  Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?$B$BHere are your tickets, $N.  Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!

7932.name: 12 Tickets - Lesser Darkmoon Prize
progress: Step right up, step right up! If you have tickets from the Darkmoon Faire you'd like redeemed, then just say so! You can redeem tickets in various denominations for wondrous and fantastic prizes. Don't be shy, give it a try!
completion: Here you go, here you go! A prize fit for a $gking:queen;! Congratulations to you, my friend!$B$BIf you have more tickets you'd like to turn in, then please let me know! For as long as the Darkmoon Faire is here, I'll redeem your tickets.

8052.name: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 19593, 'target': 'The Eye of Zuldazar', 'text': None}
completion: Smite them all and let Hakkar sort them out...
progress: If only we had ten-thousand more like you, $n. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye.$B$B<Al'tabim sighs.>$B$BAlas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.

8076.name: Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Mantle
desc: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The demoniac seeks to embody power outright, not just possess it. More than one of our demoniacs has lost a fight with a demon; with our enemies threatening us - especially in Zul'Gurub - the power that a demoniac is able to unleash on our foes is worth the sacrifice. Our survival depends on crushing those who would destroy us; the fall of the Gurubashi Empire taught us this.
Travel to Zul'Gurub and gain the Paragons of Power we need. Do this, and a valuable demoniac item shall be yours.
completion: Well done, $N. The Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub should act as a reminder of wasted power. The Gurubashi were strong at their height, but they allowed themselves to be consumed by it. A demoniac knows that the game they play is much similar, but the power unleashed is often the very thing needed for survival.
Use this mantle as an honored ally of the Zandalar... it will serve you well.
progress: Retrieved the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub?  While we will take the latent power from these items and make them our own, we will give you your own reward of power should you be successful...

8124.name: More Resource Crates
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.$B$BYou can help us, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
progress: $N, the Defilers has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more resource crates and bring them to me.
completion: Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.$B$BOnce again, thank you $N. Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by grunt and high warlord alike.

8148.name: The Maelstrom's Wrath
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 19620, 'target': "Maelstrom's Tendril", 'text': None}
completion: Your journey has only just begun, young $c. Perhaps one day you will visit the Maelstrom and glance into the heart of the world.
I wish you power and fortitude!
progress: Molthor delivers word from King Rastakhan, $n. The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. Hand it to me.

8196.name: Essence Mangoes
progress: The extremely potent essence mango grows across many of the islands in the South Seas. A single mango will refresh those who eat it, both physically and mentally. If you've never had one, you do yourself a disservice!$b$bWe have enough of a supply here on the isle to offer you a handful in exchange for a Zandalar Honor Token. Speak with Vinchaxa if you need to learn how to get tokens; otherwise, let's get to the business at hand!
completion: A fair trade, my friend - please enjoy the luscious fruits of the South Seas, with the tribe's blessing.

8268.name: Ribbons of Sacrifice
desc: Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Sentinel Farsong so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf.
objectives: Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Sentinel Farsong so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf.
details: I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important.

Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you weren't able to win this time.
completion: Well, you did not flee in the face of defeat. You stood your ground, $N, and when it comes right down to it, that is what makes for a true hero. No doubt you will win next time... but nonetheless we thank you for your effort.

8292.name: Talismans of Merit
desc: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
details: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
completion: Thank you, $N. Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.

8316.name: Armaments of War
completion: War comes, $N, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
Should this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
B<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>
The future of us all could be at an end.
These armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

8364.name: Abyssal Scepters
progress: You've truly exceeded all my expectations, $N. You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.$B$BAt this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer and their overlords.$B$BBring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward.
completion: I knew you'd come through, $N! Here's your reward.

8388.name: For Great Honor
desc: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
progress: Arathi is still wet with the blood of great warriors and the clash of steel still rings throughout Alterac. Do not waste my time unless you bring news from the front!
completion: You continue to honor the Horde, $N. I'm glad to see you haven't turned soft.

8412.name: Spirit Totem
desc: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
objectives: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
details: The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.
You know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me. We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature. More primal.
In the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes. The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.
completion: Great, mon! Let's try it out...
progress: The spirits know what we're up to, and they been tryin' to kill me! I hope you got the parts.

8436.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

The battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $N!
completion: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, $N.
progress: You've come back with news from Arathi, $C?

8460.name: Timbermaw Ally
desc: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
objectives: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
details: The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.

Are you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.
completion: We suffer much from the events of the past. Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw. As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.
progress: Keep at it, $N. If you are to earn our trust, you will need to prove yourself to us.

8484.name: The Brokering of Peace
desc: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
details: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, $N. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
completion: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in the affairs of Kalimdor... one that the Night Elves cannot support on their own. I will notify the other leaders of the Alliance of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!
As for you, $N... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. I thank you, as does the whole of the Alliance.
progress: $C, you are welcomed in my domain.  Ironforge should always be considered a home to a hero such as yourself.  Now, what business do you have with me?

8508.name: Field Duty Papers
progress: I take it you want those papers signed, $Glad:lass;?
completion: Aye, I suppose that little skirmish will pass as field duty nowadays. Take these back to Cenarion Hold, I'm sure they'll have a cushy job ready for you.$B$BOff you go!

8532.name: The Horde Needs Copper Bars!
desc: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: So glad that you've decided to help out here. Not everyone would, so I need to make sure you understand what it is that I need. Copper bars, not copper ore. We don't have the time or people to do all of the smelting ourselves, so if you would be so kind as to take care of that, your efforts will be duly noted. Is that something that you can handle, $c?
completion: These bars will do, and thanks for not shining them. No sense in making them pretty when they're going to be mangled for whatever materiel needs to be built for the war. I'll take care of putting them on the stacks, and I'll make sure that they are put to proper use. Speak to me again if you're interested in bringing in another twenty.
progress: I hope that's the twenty copper bars you have there with you, $C.

8556.name: Signet of Unyielding Strength
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
The gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
Bring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.
progress: Did you bring me the ring and materials, $N?

8580.name: The Horde Needs Firebloom!
desc: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: Hey, $c. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!
Pele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
completion: Cross your fingers, friend! Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
progress: Are you done collecting those samples? We could lose Noggle any minute now!

8604.name: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: Greetings, $c. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.
If you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
completion: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
progress: The dredge strikers are a serious threat and must be dealt with quickly!

8628.name: Avenger's Crown
desc: Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
details: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.$B$BIn my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.$B$BBring me the components I require, $N.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
progress: Have you collected the components I require?
completion: From the materials you bring and from the scales of our fallen Qiraji foes I make you these pauldrons, mortal. May they grant you the protection you need and may the sight of them strike fear into our enemies.

8652.name: Graveborn the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8676.name: Wildmane the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8700.name: Band of Unending Life
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
The gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
Bring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $g fellow : sister; druid.
completion: I will swap the gems on the ring for you. You'll find the finished piece is much more... agreeable.
progress: Did you bring me the ring and materials, $N?

8724.name: Morningdew the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8748.name: The Path of the Protector
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 21196, 'target': 'Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight', 'text': None}
completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

collectItems.name: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

progress: Your continued defense of the children of Kalimdor has been acknowledged. Hand me your signet ring so that I may enhance its powers.

8772.name: Target: Hive'Zora Waywatchers
desc: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Waywatchers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
objectives: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Waywatchers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
details: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Waywatchers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
progress: You have something to tell me, $C?
completion: Excellent work, $N. Your part in the attack on Hive'Zora has been noted.

8796.name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
desc: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
objectives: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
details: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $N!
You should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
completion: Hail and well met lad! Good to see so many of the Alliance, such as yourself, $N , coming out to lend your support in laying the groundwork for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. The effort here will ensure that we are victorious against the Silithid and their evil masters hidden away inside Ahn'Qiraj. $B So now that you are here, be sure to speak with the various collectors and offer your assistance in gathering those materials that you are suited to.

8820.name: Ten Commendation Signets
progress: I accept commendation signets from adventurers who have received them in the line of duty. For each set of ten that you hand to me, I'll make sure that you receive a significant acknowledgement of your deeds with Ironforge. I also accept single tokens, but at a much reduced rate of recognition. We are much more interested in greater feats of duty, though no feat will be ignored.$B$BWith that said, I'll gladly take your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
completion: Excellent! It is no small sacrifice that you've made to earn these signets, and you will be acknowledged for your service appropriately. It's adventurers like you, $N, that truly make a difference.$B$BLet me know if you have additional signets to hand in; I'll gladly help you out with whatever ones you need exchanged.

8844.name: One Commendation Signet
progress: For those adventurers who have but a single commendation signet, I'll exchange it for a small amount of recognition with the Darkspear tribe.$B$BPlease bear in mind that it is better to hand over a stack of ten signets at once; your efforts will receive greater recognition in doing so.  We offer a single signet exchange as a service for those who don't have enough for a full stack of ten.$B$BWith that being said, I stand ready to assist you if you still wish to hand in a single signet.
completion: Very well - your deeds have been entered into the records, and you are duly recognized for your efforts. Keep up the good work, $C.$B$BIf you have any more signets to hand in, then I am able to assist you further in that regard.

8868.name: Elune's Blessing
desc: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
objectives: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
details: The beast Omen was once a hero of this world. A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics. Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.
Finally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara. But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...
Gather cohorts, $N, and summon and defeat the beast Omen. Earn the blessing of Elune!
completion: Very well done, $n. Defeating Omen sent his spirit back to the waters of Elune'ara. Although the beast himself is blessed by Elune and so cannot die, his anger will subside for another year.$b$bYour victory is a celebration, $n--a celebration of the might of Omen, of you and your allies, and of the peace you have given this tragic hero of our past.

8916.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Devout Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Devout Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.$B
completion: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
Those bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.
progress: Have you obtained the items I require, $N?

8940.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
For now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.
progress: You're ready to perform the exchange?

8964.name: Components of Importance
desc: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.

The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
completion: A job well done, $N. I will imbue the essence of the sword into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to get into The Crimson Throne inside The Scarlet Bastion at Stratholme, and use the brazier to summon forth the remains of my former cohorts, Jarien and Sothos. Their souls have been twisted further by their possession of Valthalak's amulet piece and his spirit within.
progress: Have you returned already then, $C, with what I sent you out to gather?

8988.name: More Components of Importance
desc: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

An ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
completion: A job well done, $N. I will imbue the essence of the ashes into the brazier.

Now all that is left is to get into Scholomance, to Ras Frostwhisper's chamber, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Kormok. The amulet piece, and Valthalak's spirit within, has corrupted him even further, and he will not rest until you forcibly take it from him.
Oh, by the way, I had some leftover bloodkelp from your trip to Alcaz Isle, so I made it into some potions for you. Take your pick!
progress: Have you returned already then, $C, with what I sent you out to gather?

9012.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Dreadmist Mask and Dreadmist Robe.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
Enjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!
progress: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Dreadmist pieces in exchange for your new Deathmist Mask and Robe?

9036.name: Dreadnaught Legplates
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Legplates if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Legplates, 20 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Dreadnaught Legplates.

9060.name: Cryptstalker Girdle
desc: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.
details: I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.$B$BBring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Cryptstalker Girdle.

9084.name: Bonescythe Bracers
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Bracers if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 2 Cured Rugged Hides and 10 gold pieces.
details: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
progress: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
completion: The bracers are ready, $N.$B$B<Rohan bows.>

9108.name: Plagueheart Gloves
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Gloves if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gloves, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps and 4 Mooncloth.
details: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.$B$BAnd I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Plagueheart Gloves.

9132.name: Dark Iron Scraps
progress: For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. Now get out of my sight before I split you in two!
completion: That's all you brought me? Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. I need MORE!

9204.name: Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel
desc: Deliver 40 Stonescale Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.$B$BWork Order FS-5:$B$B40 Stonescale Eel.$B$BAll filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BContract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.$B$B-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
progress: Filling a work order, $C?
completion: You could have used this for something else, but you didn't, did you? No use crying about it now, $N.

9228.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
objectives: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
details: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
completion: Good day, $N. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

9300.name: Page from the Front
desc: Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
There is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
Thank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.
progress: Yes? What do you have there?

9324.name: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
objectives: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
completion: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame!
progress: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?

79092.name: Archmage Theocritus's Research Journal
progress:
Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Archmage Theocritus's Research Journal ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Our knowledge expands through your efforts. $B If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79980.name: Scramble
details: Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going.
completion: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

84396.name: Magma or Lava?
progress:
Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Magma or Lava? ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Our knowledge expands through your efforts. $B If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

91740.name: Croaky's Head
objectives: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.

91860.name: A Grim Fate
objectives: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
details: Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.
If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.
I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.

92124.name: Book Inventory
objectives: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
details: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!
Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.
He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.
Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

92460.name: Coming of Age
objectives: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
details: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.
Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
desc: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime. ...

92484.name: Embracing the Elements
objectives: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
* Humming Recall Crystal (provided)
details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
progress: Winds guide you, <name>.

92532.name: The Warrior's Path
details: While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.
Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
objectives: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
* Crumpled Note (Zephras Isle) (provided)
completion: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.
Good luck, <name>, may the winds guide you.
progress: So you've come for training, then?

92700.name: The Grand Skyseer
objectives: Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

92748.name: Toxic Soil (part 5)
objectives: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
details: The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of . We need to stop it, quickly.
Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.

93036.name: Infiltrating the Cult
objectives: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

93948.name: Deliver the Signet
objectives: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

95508.name: Unwelcome Guests
objectives: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
* Assist Walton
details: Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.
There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?
There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

95772.name: Songblade Search
objectives: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
details: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.
Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.
Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.
If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?

96876.name: Ukor's Lost Pack
details: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
objectives: Return the pack to Ukor in southern .
*Ukor's Lost Pack (provided)
completion: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!
progress: Something need doing?

97908.name: Camping 101: Skinning
objectives: Speak with Thuwd in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

99108.name: Sparring Match
objectives: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.

99156.name: Rear Guard Patrol (2/2)
objectives: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
*Riptear's Heart
details: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.
Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.
Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.
See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
progress: Have you dealt with our little problem?
